name: Lê Phương Nhi
title: Immerse
tagline: A visual odyssey beneath the waves

story.quote: Sometimes to find yourself, you must first let yourself dissolve.
If you still know how to look up, the sea will teach you to see yourself again.
Art isn't for the eyes — it's for the quiet between souls.
Beauty lives not in perfection, but in the courage to touch the unknown.
Freedom is the moment when the soul transcends fear.
Pain is the seed of beauty, if one is kind enough to let it grow.
Perhaps self-love isn't about being strong, but about being gentle with what's still healing.
